thread:
support_jordan: Hey @oncall — customer FinServCo opened a ticket: since ~03:00 UTC their observed p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.9s and they're seeing intermittent 502s. Trace IDs: trace=ab12cd34, ef56gh78. They're on Dedicated us-west2. Can someone triage?

oncall_maya: looking now. linking runbook: /runbooks/latency-triage. marking P1.

oncall_maya: quick check — alerts fired at 03:12 UTC for p99 threshold breach. p95 also up but less severe.

metrics_rita: FYI the dashboard panel gen_latency uses a rollup-quantile over 5m windows (histogram->quantile). Raw trace-based p99 (from APM) shows a heavier tail. Might be aggregation/rollup mismatch.

eng_tom: any deploys around 02:50-03:10?

bot_deploy: Deploy completed: model-serving-service v2.7.1 -> v2.8.0 by @eng_tom at 02:58 UTC (build 2026-03-17T02:58Z).

eng_tom: we rolled a feature flag: kv-cache-sharding + new batch horizon. I pushed it at 02:57 as part of the rollout.

infra_lee: checking proxy and backend. I see a spike of 502s from auth-proxy at ~03:05. Proxy logs show backend hung waiting on kv-store for seconds -> proxy timed out and returned 502. Snippet:

```
2026-03-17T03:05:12.456Z auth-proxy[pid=4021] upstream_timeout id=ef56gh78 path=/v1/generate code=502 rt=1204ms backend_wait=1188ms kv_miss=true
2026-03-17T03:05:13.789Z model-svc[pid=880] request_id=ef56gh78 stage=wait_kv miss_prefix=customer-123 tokens=1024
```

support_kim: customer also mentioned seeing some 401s earlier but that could be client-side retries bubbling.

eng_tom: i can reproduce locally with long sequence requests (max_tokens=1024) + streaming when kv-cache-sharding flag enabled — p99 goes up. Looks like sharding introduced higher cache miss tail for hot prefixes.

metrics_rita: also note: the Grafana panel uses linear bucketization now — we switched from power-of-two buckets last week. That changed how tail weight looks in dashboards; panels may disagree depending on bucket boundaries and whether retries are included. If retries or 5xxs are included in rollup, quantiles can be pulled upward.

oncall_maya: runbook actions suggested: 1) revert the flag, 2) enable fallback routing to older pool, 3) patch dashboard to filter out retries/5xx, 4) notify customer.

eng_tom: rolling back the feature flag now.

bot_deploy: Rollback triggered: revert kv-cache-sharding by @eng_tom at 03:28 UTC.

bot_deploy: Rollback completed: model-serving-service v2.7.1 restored at 03:31 UTC.

infra_lee: after rollback 502s drop off; by 03:36 proxy 502 rate down to baseline. p99 trending down but still ~600ms for some customers.

metrics_rita: residual p99 delta explained: cache-warmup and inflated retries. New code path caused cache misses for hot prefixes; once traffic hits, warm-up reduces latency but initial requests are expensive which hikes p99. Also dashboards differ because one panel was aggregating over 5m rollups (which smear out brief spikes) and another panel was using raw traces. We should standardize queries.

eng_tom: immediate mitigation: rollback + synchronous warm-up patch for hot prefixes (PR #4123) to reduce miss amplification. Longer term: add backpressure on kv missers and gate the sharding behind gradual canary with long-sequence synthetic traffic.

metrics_rita: suggested Grafana query change (panel_id=gen_latency) — add filters: response_code < 500 AND retry_count = 0 AND environment = "prod-dedicated-us-west2". Also set aggregation method to use raw-trace p99 for critical SLO panels.

```
-- EXAMPLE (Grafana/PromQL-ish):
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="model-svc",env="prod-dedicated-us-west2",response_code!~"5..",retry_count="0"}[1m])) by (le))
```

support_jordan: customer update drafted: "We rolled back a recent performance change and are continuing to monitor; we believe a cache-sharding change caused transient tail latency. We'll follow up with a permanent fix and better rollout canaries." Sending now.

eng_tom: root cause summary: kv-cache-sharding change changed miss distribution for hot prefixes and interacted poorly with proxy retry behavior, amplifying backend stalls and producing 502s. Rollback removed the new code path; patch will warm hot keys and throttle miss concurrency.

oncall_maya: follow-ups for eng: 1) add canary type that includes long-sequence streaming traffic, 2) add dashboard annotation for deploy + bucketization change, 3) update runbook to check both rollup and raw-trace p99.

metrics_rita: i'll push a dashboard note and update the panel queries. also will run backfill to compare rollup vs trace p99 across the incident window.

support_kim: customer confirms improved perf after rollback and thanks the team. keeping ticket open for root-cause docs.

eng_tom: PR #4123 opened for synchronous warm-up; will schedule a controlled canary with @oncall_maya next week.

oncall_maya: thanks all. marking this as incident resolved->postmortem required. assigning to eng_tom + metrics_rita. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

support_jordan: closing loop with customer and adding postmortem link when ready. (reaction :thumbsup:)
